myDataValue.com | Senior Founding Engineer | Fully Remote (UK Only) | £90k + 2% equity | Raising at £5m round

We are an AI-driven Hospitality Tech platform helping vacation rental owners automate their revenue on Booking.com. We are bootstrapped, profitable (£100k ARR), and growing month-on-month.

We are looking for a Founding Engineer (Python/Django) to partner with us (2 founders) and scale our infrastructure. This is a fullstack role (React) involving high-volume scraping, browser automation & agents.

- Stack: Python, Django, Postgres, React

- Challenge: Enterprise-scale scraping (1000s req/s), reverse engineering, and AI agents.

- Deal: £70k - £90k + Up to 2% Equity.

We are currently raising a round at £5m valuation with top VC's.

Apply here: https://www.mydatavalue.com/founding-full-stack-senior-engin...

Or email me your cv: martin@mydatavalue.com
